Two reference images wired in order: image 1 is her full-body cyan light-armor cut, shoulder cannon, and combat stance; image 2 locks face, short cyan hair, headset, and LED chest/shoulder. Same identity-locked heroine throughout—image 1 for silhouette/armor, image 2 for face. NIGHT CHASE / ENTER-WORLD game cinematic: she must reach the glowing zone gate and clear the drone blocking it. Timer and score HUD flipping in corners only; shoulder-cannon burst. 5-second 16:9 high-end playful AAA trailer feel. Reject quiet face punch-ins only, seated poses, vulgar cheap cyber, top-down ugly showcase.

[0-1.6s] Wide night city rooftop: she sprints matching image-1 silhouette toward a distant ENTERING ZONE gate; ENTERING ZONE banner streaks; TIMER 00:45→00:42 and SCORE 9800→10150 flip in crisp corner HUD; cyan armor LEDs strobe with footfalls. HARD CUT.
[1.6-3.4s] Same leap continues—shoulder-level chase cam: she vaults the gap, twists, lands on the gate roof; shoulder rail locks on the drone blocking the doorway; AMMO 40→37 and a red lock diamond snap; she fires a cyan cannon burst with recoil micro-tremor; damage 860 floats. HARD CUT.
[3.4-5s] Three-quarter hold: she slides through the open gate, lands hard, chin raised, face readable from image 2; MISSION CLEAR +1200 and timer freeze 00:38 pop; cooldown ring pulses once; clear subject, shallow DOF, restrained anamorphic edge; no black frames.

Audio: night wind + timer ticks → vault whoosh + rail shot + lock beep → clear chime; no dialogue, no lyrics.
